Exit-gate ordering fixed. Root: _PENDING_EXIT['active'] was set after the LLM call (~line 3152), so [EXIT_IN_TRANSIT] was never injected on the FIRST 'take five' turn — eLo immediately said 'stepping away' before the body confirmed gone. Fix: early-detect _STEP_OUT_PHRASES frozenset before g_ctx enrichment at line ~2555; set _PENDING_EXIT['active']=True on the same turn so the gate fires. LLM now sees [EXIT_IN_TRANSIT] and is forbidden from claiming departure until exit_complete ACKs. 7/7 AT test_wo045b_exit_gate_ordering.py + 6/6 test_wo045_take_five.py clean. David: say 'take five' — eLo should hold 'stepping away' until body exit completes.
